title: Band-9 Samples: Which social media websites do you use?
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 1 Test 2 question:

“Which social media websites do you use?”

Sample 1: Using Social Media

I predominantly use Facebook and Instagram, as they cater to my penchant for visual content and facilitate effortless communication with my friends and acquaintances. Facebook allows me to stay abreast of current events, while Instagram indulges my creative side by offering a plethora of inspiring images and stories.

Sample 2: Using Social Media

LinkedIn and Twitter are my go-to social media platforms. LinkedIn provides an excellent arena for professional networking, skill enhancement, and job opportunities, whereas Twitter offers succinct updates and opinions on various topics, enabling me to engage in thought-provoking discussions and stay well-informed.

Sample 3: Using Social Media

Among the numerous social media options, I prefer TikTok for its commitment to concise video storytelling. The platform’s time constraints push users to be more inventive and resourceful in conveying their message, which ultimately leads to more captivating content. Additionally, TikTok’s advanced algorithm consistently serves up content tailored to my preferences, further enhancing my overall experience.

Sample 4: Using Social Media

YouTube has become my social media platform of choice, as it offers both knowledge and entertainment in one convenient location. I appreciate its vast library of videos, which allows me to explore my passions and discover new interests. Additionally, YouTube has proven invaluable in my journey to learn English, offering an abundance of language-focused channels and resources that make the learning process both enjoyable and effective.

Sample 5: Using Social Media

I primarily utilize Pinterest in my day-to-day life, as it is highly relevant to my profession. As a graphic designer, I find that this platform serves as a goldmine of inspiration, providing me with a plethora of creative ideas and concepts. Moreover, it facilitates seamless networking with other creatives in my field, fostering a sense of camaraderie and collaboration.

Sample 6: Using Social Media

Among the social media websites I frequent, Reddit holds a special place due to its user-driven content. It presents a dynamic environment where I can participate in thought-provoking discussions and challenge my own preconceptions. By interacting with people from diverse backgrounds and cultures, I can develop a more nuanced understanding of the world around me and cultivate a spirit of open-mindedness.

Sample 7: Not Using Social Media

To be honest, I don’t actively engage with social media websites due to my concerns about excessive screen time and information overload. However, I still maintain personal connections by using messaging apps like Messenger and Zalo to chat with friends. This approach enables me to preserve meaningful relationships while avoiding the pitfalls of continuous exposure to the overwhelming amount of content found on social media platforms.

Sample 8: Not Using Social Media

As a matter of fact, I have made a deliberate decision to abstain from using social media websites. Instead, I channel my energy towards more enriching activities such as reading, exploring new hobbies, or participating in community events. This approach allows me to broaden my horizons and develop my interpersonal skills in a more authentic way.

Sample 9: Not Using Social Media

In contrast to popular trends, I abstain from using social media websites. I am a strong advocate for living in the present moment, and I believe that social media often detracts from this by encouraging constant comparisons and validation-seeking behavior. By forgoing social media, I can focus on embracing the beauty of my everyday experiences and cultivating a more grounded sense of self.

Sample 10: Not Using Social Media

Surprisingly, I refrain from using social media websites altogether. The primary reason for this choice is to maintain my mental well-being, as I have observed that being constantly exposed to social media can lead to feelings of anxiety and self-doubt. Additionally, steering clear of social networking sites allows me to focus on more productive pursuits and cultivate deeper connections with friends and family through face-to-face interactions.
